events.speaker: Ship Core
events.text: Power returns in quiet waves. Your starter ship floats above a training world, patched together but responsive.

events.title: Calibration
events.text: This public demo uses original placeholder text and art. Private chapter assets can be added locally later without entering Git.

events.speaker: Ship Core
events.text: A training vessel drifts nearby. How do you begin the systems check?

choices.text: Let the ship guide the scan.

events.speaker: Ship Core
events.text: The scan resolves into a clean profile. Your interface records the vessel as a harmless training target.

events.title: Enhanced Reading
events.text: Your upgraded scanner catches faint resource echoes beyond the training orbit.

events.title: Basic Reading
events.text: The basic scanner marks a nearby asteroid field as safe enough for a short mining drill.

events.speaker: Ship Core
events.text: The star map opens with two reachable locations. Choose a destination for the next exercise.

events.title: Asteroid Drill
events.text: The field is stable. Tap asteroids to identify useful material before the drill window closes.

events.speaker: Ship Core
events.text: A training drone powers up. Its weapons are tuned low, but the battle loop is real enough to test your ship.

events.title: Training Rewards
events.text: The drone powers down. The ship authorizes a small upgrade budget for your next modification.

events.speaker: Ship Core
events.text: The starter ship settles into a steadier rhythm. The framework is ready for future chapters, stranger systems, and private local content.

events.title: Demo Chapter Complete
events.text: You completed the public demo flow: story, choice, scan, map, mining, battle, reward, and upgrade.
